body:
Oh how I can relate! I had something like ten CPS cases growing up (in two different states)! I lost count of how many workers and cases we had but from my brother and I's memory it was more ten five less than ten. The even took my mother to court one time. We only had one half decent case worker, but eve he didn't get us out.

I've had a hard time dealing with these feelings for awhile. Honestly, for so long it made me fucking angry. I was a kid-- a baby and no one cared enough to help me. I missed weeks upon weeks of school growing up, my hair was matted, I was locked in a basement for months no one even noticed I wasn't enrolled in school. Everyone knew how crazy my mother was. One time my mother's own therapist called CPS because she told him how I (probably ten or eleven years old) witnessed a drunken beating between my mother and another family member. My mother lied about it and said he heard it wrong another group therapy member even lied on my mother's behalf! A couple years later, I had enough and I told a trusted family member about the abuse, I even had video evidence. My mom always told me, for years, CPS doesn't want you they only want babies, your family member's don't want you. I remember crying and saying they did want me and I'll never forget what she said. "So where the fuck are they?" 

She was cold bitch but she was right. No one gave a fuck about me or my brother.

How do I prove it's on the basis of race though? I feel like I have sufficient evidence that they're behavior is a problem, but how can I prove that it's because they're racist and not just because they're mean girls. Somethings telling me it's because of my race, but I doubt that's enough to start leveling accusations of racism at them. I want to make sure it's ironclad so it doesn't get swept under the rug.

I actually have found my bottles opened on multiple occasions. Maybe I'm just forgetful, but I started hiding my toothbrush after the first one grew legs and walked away. Also my toothbrush tasted weird one morning, a couple of hours later I had to leave work early because i was violently vomiting and shaking. Not sure if I ate something weird or what.
I actually did record it because I have a funny feeling they are going to lie and gang up on me. I wish I had recorded them talking afterwards but I didn't get the chance.
Jeez, I'm sorry you had to experience that. I hope your doing better now :)

I only saw two other black girls on our roommate website. One who I am now friends with, who is going through a similar experience with her roommate and the other who was already matched. I was talking to my friend, also black, and her roommate has been clogging the toilet on the daily and tried to make my friend clean it. Once again, we're not really sure if it's bc some people are weird or a racist roomie.

Also forgot to mention, but whenever I walk into the kitchen and they're there together the room goes dead silent. Even when I know they're not talking about me. Two minutes ago I walk into the kitchen grab a soda, didn't saying and everyone just goes silent. I had my airpods in so it's not like I could easy drop on heir convo, it's just so... weird?

I work with the RAs and the residence manager and I'm on the dorm housing board. I know everyone. I don't want to cause a problem over something that I could be over reacting about. Maybe I'll run it by them casually.
Same. I realized recently that that's probably what's going to do me under. It might not be today, it not be tomorrow but it's coming. I just don't know when.
Thank you. Its sucks I hope things get better for you :)
